---
title: "Presentation title"
subtitle: "Subtitle, course, or venue"
date: "`r format(Sys.Date(), '%B %d, %Y')`"
output:
  xaringan::moon_reader:
    css:
      - default
      - assets/fonts.css
      - assets/northwestern-primary.css
      - assets/northwestern-secondary.css
      - assets/animations.css
    self_contained: true
    seal: false
    nature:
      ratio: "16:9"
      highlightStyle: github
      highlightLines: true
      countIncrementalSlides: false
      slideNumberFormat: "%current%"
      navigation:
        scroll: false
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
options(htmltools.dir.version = FALSE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.align = "center",
  fig.width = 8,
  fig.height = 4.5,
  dpi = 144,
  out.width = "92%"
)

profile <- yaml::read_yaml("_profile.yml")
source("assets/colors.R")
```
